task_title: Route MCP + ralph-loop state DB opens through the guarded helper so they fail with the corrupt-state diagnostic
task_criteria: With 4KB random bytes at .speclang/speclang.db, the MCP status/tool path and ralph-loop both exit non-zero with CorruptStateDatabaseError naming the path; tests cover both; no direct new Database(.speclang/speclang.db) remains

items.criterion: With 4KB random bytes at .speclang/speclang.db, the MCP status/tool path and ralph-loop both exit non-zero with CorruptStateDatabaseError naming the path; tests cover both; no direct new Database(.speclang/speclang.db) remains
items.detail: PASS: tests/db/corrupt-state-db-surfaces.test.ts 7/7 pass (npx vitest run tests/db/corrupt-state-db-surfaces.test.ts --reporter=verbose, exit 0). Covers: MCP SpeclangDatabase corrupt->CorruptStateDatabaseError w/ filePath+message; ralph LoopController.create corrupt->same; both real entry points (tsx src/speclang-mcp.ts, tsx src/ralph-loop.ts) exit 1 with diagnostic lines and no /SqliteError/. Code: speclang-mcp.ts:79-80 openStateDatabase+withStateDatabase, main() 676-690 exit 1; ralph-loop.ts:50 openStateDatabase, main() 264-281 exit 1; controller.ts:42 openStateDatabase; validation-system.ts:403 openStateDatabase. Remaining `new Database(`: sqlite.spec.dir/src/index.ts:104 (the helper itself), implementation.spec.dir/src/db/speclang-db.ts:36 (no importers anywhere), roadmap poc-db.ts:104 (POC), ralph-loop.spec.dir/src/controller.js:34 (stale compiled JS, TS resolution picks controller.ts). Real CLI `speclang mcp start` (bin/speclang:1382) -> dist/specs/mcp.spec.dir/src/server.js initDatabase -> createDatabase -> SpecLangDB -> openStateDatabase (guarded). `speclang mcp status` (bin/speclang:1414) never opens the DB (pid/status files only). npm run build exit 0; tests/db 60 passed; tests/mcp 90 passed.

items.criterion: The real CLI entrypoint `speclang mcp start` (bin/speclang:1382) reaches the guarded openStateDatabase, so a corrupt .speclang/speclang.db surfaces CorruptStateDatabaseError with a non-zero exit rather than a raw SqliteError.
items.detail: PASS: real CLI `node bin/speclang mcp start` in a project with 4KB random bytes at .speclang/speclang.db -> EXIT=1, stderr contains "CorruptStateDatabaseError: The SpecLang state database is corrupt or not a SQLite database: <abs path>" + docs/troubleshooting.md "Emergency Recovery" + rm -f line; stdout empty (no "server running"). Path: bin/speclang:1382 -> dist/specs/mcp.spec.dir/src/server.js:84 initDatabase -> createDatabase -> SpecLangDB -> openStateDatabase (dist/specs/sqlite.spec.dir/src/index.js:115). Note: `speclang mcp status` (bin/speclang:1414) never opens the DB (pid/status files only) -> EXIT=0 "Status: Not running"; the DB-opening MCP path is `mcp start`/tool path.

items.criterion: The ralph-loop entrypoint (specs/implementation.spec.dir/src/ralph-loop.ts main()) reaches the guarded openStateDatabase and exits non-zero with the CorruptStateDatabaseError diagnostic naming the path.
items.detail: PASS: `tsx src/ralph-loop.ts` in a project with 4KB random bytes at .speclang/speclang.db -> EXIT=1, stderr = the diagnostic naming ".speclang/speclang.db" + docs/troubleshooting.md Emergency Recovery + rm -f line, no SqliteError, stdout empty. require.main guard at specs/implementation.spec.dir/src/ralph-loop.ts:280 fires under tsx (CommonJS package type). Same for `tsx src/speclang-mcp.ts` -> EXIT=1 with the same diagnostic.
